subject: general
question: During a journey a person travels half of the distance at a speed of 18 km/h and the remaining half of the journey at a speed of 22 km/h. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
solution:
Given:

A person travels half of the distance at a speed of 18 km/h and the remaining half of the journey at a speed of 22 km/h

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Average speed = 2S₁S₂/(S₁ + S₂)

Calculation:

Here, S₁ = 18 km/h

S₂ = 22 km/h

Average speed = 2S1S2/(S1 + S2)

Average speed = 2 × 18 × 22 /(18 + 22)

⇒ 19.8 km/h

∴ His average speed during the entire journey is 19.8 km/h.
